summary: Employee Management System fully tested. Backend: 29/29 tests passed. Frontend: All 5 tabs working correctly (Employees, Add Employee, Attendance, Salary Slips, Pool Wallet).
critical_code_review_comments: All backend endpoints properly implemented with validation and error handling
Salary breakdown calculation follows Indian standard (Basic 40%, HRA 20%, PF 12% of Basic capped at 15000, ESI 0.75% if gross <= 21000, PT 200 if salary > 10000)
Frontend uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Pool wallet distribution logic correctly implements salary-proportional distribution with monthly caps
seed_data_creation: Test employee EMP-0001 already exists (User Profile Test 999, Technology, Software Developer, ₹25,000). Attendance marked for April 2026 (18 days present).
